sentences.text: I could not determine the foreclosure charge for car loans from the evidence provided because the in-force loan documents shown are for home loans, not car loans.
The in-force home-loan documents state a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure, while a copied version states 3% of the principal outstanding.
For an urban co-operative bank in a case outside the specific exceptions, the applicable rule says pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of the UCB.

missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force bank documents and the rule findings provided, but the evidence only shows home-loan foreclosure/pre-payment charges and does not provide a car-loan policy or car-loan charge schedule.
